description: Show the organization's plan, its limits and current usage, to check that new monitors, heartbeats or regions fit before creating them or to explain a 403 naming a limit. Region codes and their cities come from list_regions; billing changes happen only in the dashboard. Values are current as of the call. Returns plan (one of FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX, ENTERPRISE), limits and usage. limits: max_monitors, min_interval_seconds, max_fast_monitors (monitors below fast_interval_threshold_seconds, 60), max_regions per monitor, allowed_regions, max_heartbeats, max_maintenance_windows, max_status_pages, max_status_page_subscribers, max_channels, max_api_keys, history_retention_days, api_rate_limit_per_minute (shared by the whole organization), min_reminder_interval_seconds (the shortest reminder interval the plan allows; open, unacknowledged incidents are recalled in one digest per channel); renotify_interval_seconds and renotify_max_count are deprecated and carry no separate meaning; null means no limit. usage: monitors (paused included), fast_monitors, heartbeats, channels (member email channels excluded), api_keys (keys that still authenticate) and status_page_subscribers (confirmed, organization-wide), each next to its limit above.
name: get_plan_usage

items.description: Known values: EMAIL, TELEGRAM, WEBHOOK, SLACK, DISCORD.

tier.description: Known values: FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX, ENTERPRISE.

plan.description: Known values: FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX, ENTERPRISE.

api_keys.description: API keys that still authenticate (not revoked, deleted or expired); count toward max_api_keys.

channels.description: Notification channels counted toward max_channels (member email channels never count).

fast_monitors.description: Monitors with an interval below the fast threshold.

status_page_subscribers.description: Confirmed status page subscribers across the whole organization (the cap is per organization).

title: Get plan usage
